assertions.name: red_replays_recording
assertions.detail: uses the recording's milk and date

final_message:
I added a failing test, `test_an_item_that_runs_out_today_is_expiring`, in `tests/test_api.py`. It reproduces the defect, and it is the only failure in the suite.

The test replays the HAR requests against the API. It adds milk expiring 2026-10-21 and yogurt expiring 2026-10-23, then calls `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21`. It expects `["milk", "yogurt"]` and gets `["yogurt"]`.

The cause is in `Store.expiring` in `pantry/store.py`. It filters with `today < i.expires_on <= last`, and the strict `<` drops anything expiring today. I haven't changed the code, only added the test.
